name: AIRWA public setBurnRate()
summary: AIRWA.setBurnRate(uint256) has no owner check, so the attacker set the burn rate to 98%, triggered it with a zero-value transfer to the LP to destroy the pair's AIRWA, reset it and sold into the inflated price.
